**In one line**: Nvidia is reportedly considering a stake of up to $10 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering.

### Key points
- According to a Motley Fool report, Nvidia is weighing participation in Anthropic's IPO to acquire roughly $10 billion worth of equity.
- Anthropic is a major Nvidia customer, relying on large volumes of GPUs to train and serve its models.
- The outlet framed this as Nvidia "buying its own demand" — a chipmaker investing in a customer that turns around and buys its chips.

### Why it matters
It's another instance of the "circular investment" debate running through AI infrastructure. When large chip or cloud vendors fund AI model developers whose money flows back into chip and cloud purchases, it becomes harder to separate genuine demand from inflated demand. That said, this remains at the consideration stage, not a confirmed deal.
